VIPCOO H3 Electric Dirt Bike — Adventure Starts Here
The VIPCOO H3 Electric Dirt Bike is built for riders who love the freedom of off-road exploration and the convenience of electric power. From weekend trail rides to daily outdoor adventures, this bike delivers balanced performance, reliable handling, and comfort in every ride.
With thoughtful engineering and quality components, the VIPCOO H3 is designed for adults who want a rugged, fun, and efficient way to experience off-road terrain without compromise.
Powerful Motor and Reliable Battery for Longer Rides
At the core of the VIPCOO H3 is a 3500W electric motor that provides solid power and smooth acceleration across different terrains. Whether you’re cruising through dirt trails or tackling small hills, this motor offers a dependable response and consistent performance.
Paired with a 48V 23Ah high-capacity battery, the H3 is built to support extended riding sessions without the constant need for recharging. This combination of motor and battery makes it suitable for both fun recreational rides and practical outdoor use.
Designed for Control and Comfort
Outdoor riding demands a bike that can adapt to changing surfaces, and the VIPCOO H3 is equipped to do just that. It includes a front and rear high-performance suspension system that helps absorb shock and maintain stability on uneven ground.
Stopping power is also a priority. The bike features front and rear hydraulic disc brakes that respond quickly and help keep you in control when you need to slow down or stop suddenly.
Off-Road Ready Tires
The VIPCOO H3 rolls on rugged off-road tires — 14 inches at the front and 12 inches at the rear. These sizes provide a balanced combination of traction and maneuverability, helping the bike handle loose dirt, gravel, and uneven paths with confidence.
This tire setup enhances grip and stability, giving riders the confidence to explore trails with less worry about slipping or losing balance.
Clear Digital Display and Smart Lighting
A high-definition digital instrument display gives you instant access to key riding information such as speed and battery level. It’s easy to read at a glance, helping you focus on the ride ahead.
For visibility in low-light conditions, the VIPCOO H3 comes with a bright front headlight, clear rear tail light, and integrated turn signals. These lighting features help make your rides safer when you’re navigating trails at dusk or returning home after sunset.
Multi-Speed Riding for Different Situations
The VIPCOO H3 offers three speed levels to match your riding needs:

These speed options make it easy to adapt your ride whether you’re enjoying a leisurely outing or seeking a more thrilling experience.
Key Features at a Glance

3500W electric motor for dependable power

48V 23Ah battery for extended riding range

Front and rear high-performance suspension system

Hydraulic disc brakes for controlled stopping

Off-road tires (14" front, 12" rear) for enhanced traction

High-definition digital display

Front headlight, rear tail light, and turn signals

Three-speed options for versatile riding

Why Riders Choose the VIPCOO H3
The VIPCOO H3 stands out as an electric dirt bike that doesn’t force riders to choose between power and practicality. Its combination of battery capacity, motor strength, suspension quality, and real-world riding features makes it a great choice for anyone seeking an outdoor electric ride that’s ready for adventure.
Whether you’re new to off-road biking or looking to upgrade your current ride, the VIPCOO H3 brings together performance, comfort, and style in one compelling package.
